title: [Main]- When issuing a prepayment invoice with an invoice discount applied, the prepayment amount does not take into account the total amount including tax.
summary: Fixed an issue where prepayment invoices with invoice discounts applied were not correctly including tax when the prepayment include tax setting was enabled. The reconciliation logic now uses the tax-inclusive amount as the target when calculating the prepayment difference.
key_points: Prepayment amount calculation now properly accounts for tax when invoice discount is applied
The UpdateDifferenceAmount procedure uses tax-inclusive amount for reconciliation when Prepmt. Include Tax is true
Issue only affected the invoice-discount code path; non-discount and non-include-tax scenarios unaffected
Added test cases for Canada and US locales to verify correct tax handling
